verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a complete fine-tune-and-serve loop on one platform: supervised/reinforcement fine-tuning of base models, then deploying the resulting LoRA via live-merge or multi-LoRA with a single firectl command, using the same API for both training and inference. This is corroborated by a community report of an actual SFT run completing successfully (albeit criticized on cost), confirming the workflow functions end-to-end. Missing for 10: independent quality/performance benchmarks of fine-tuned models in production and broader community corroboration beyond one pricing complaint.
